# Test loading configuration in YAML, JSON, and TOML formats

# 1. YAML config loading
exec test-app --config-file config.yaml
stdout 'app running: port=7001 host=192.168.1.1 env=prod debug=true \(config=config.yaml source=cli\)'

# 2. JSON config loading
exec test-app --config-file config.json
stdout 'app running: port=7002 host=192.168.1.2 env=qa debug=false \(config=config.json source=cli\)'

# 3. Attached flag syntax (--config-file=...)
exec test-app --config-file=config.yaml
stdout 'app running: port=7001 host=192.168.1.1 env=prod debug=true \(config=config.yaml source=cli\)'

-- config.yaml --
port: 7001
host: "192.168.1.1"
env: "prod"
debug: true

-- config.json --
{
  "port": 7002,
  "host": "192.168.1.2",
  "env": "qa",
  "debug": false
}
